contract_constants.supported_tree_shape: exactly one root-level 100644 file with path ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$

observer_contract.boundary: after the initial noesis image load until subject exit
observer_contract.network_namespace: fresh namespace with no interface up and no route for the complete boundary

conditional_process_syscalls.clone: forbidden unless decoded flags include CLONE_THREAD

observer_contract.enforcement: seccomp default-deny for the listed process, network, and async-I/O paths plus audit
required_launch_evidence: network namespace has no interface up
only file descriptors 0, 1, and 2 are inherited
no inherited descriptor is a socket
seccomp profile digest matches the reviewed profile
observer_contract.self_test: before product evidence, generate one architecture-qualified isolated probe for every syscall and conditional branch in the ratified seccomp policy; every applicable deny probe must return EPERM and a matching observer event, allowed clone-with-CLONE_THREAD must not match the deny rule, and every not_exposed result requires both libseccomp-resolution and direct-ENOSYS evidence

success.stdout: one RepositorySnapshotV1 JSON document followed by one LF

invalid_invocation.stderr: one CodeNoesisErrorV1 JSON document followed by one LF

acquisition_failure.stderr: one CodeNoesisErrorV1 JSON document followed by one LF

unexpected_internal_failure.stderr: one CodeNoesisErrorV1 JSON document followed by one LF

expected_red.precondition: The future TDD branch contains the black-box harness and a minimal noesis surface.
expected_red.runner_expected_exit: nonzero because the acceptance assertion fails
expected_red.subject_marker_lifecycle: test-only Red stub marker; it is not a public CodeNoesisErrorV1 code
expected_red.accepted_reason: The public product behavior is deliberately absent before implementation.

scenarios.arrange: Materialize fixture commit A in a fresh local SHA-1 worktree.
scenarios.act: Run the public command with the full commit A OID.
assert: Exit is 0, stderr is empty, and stdout is one strict RepositorySnapshotV1 JSON document.
Repository identity, object format, commit OID, and tree OID equal the reviewed fixture values.
The adapter verifies the complete supported commit-to-tree-to-blob closure before output.
Recomputed RFC 8785 semantic bytes and domain-separated BLAKE3-256 equal the artifact hash.
No absolute path, hostname, user name, or volatile value appears under semantic.

scenarios.arrange: Use the real local Git adapter and object database to bind refs/heads/main while it names A, then have the harness move the real ref to B.
scenarios.act: Complete verification from the already returned BoundRevision.
assert: The bound commit and tree remain A.
A new binding resolves B.
The real adapter does not reread the ref while consuming the first binding; a fake cannot substitute for this test.

scenarios.arrange: Create a plain directory containing the fixture source but no Git metadata.
scenarios.act: Run the public command against that directory.
assert: Exit is 10 and stdout is empty.
Stderr is one strict CodeNoesisErrorV1 with code acquisition.not_git_repository.
No partial snapshot or absolute path is emitted.

scenarios.arrange: Materialize A, remove its referenced blob object, and retain the commit and tree.
scenarios.act: Scan the full A commit OID.
assert: Exit is 10 with acquisition.object_missing.
Context identifies the missing full OID, expected kind, and referring tree OID.
No partial snapshot is emitted.

scenarios.arrange: Materialize A and replace one referenced loose object with validly framed content whose SHA-1 differs from its filename.
scenarios.act: Scan the full A commit OID.
assert: Exit is 10 with acquisition.repository_inconsistent.
The error does not expose raw object content or a local path.
No partial snapshot is emitted.

scenarios.arrange: Start from the reviewed successful artifact and generate one mutation per required or unknown property.
assert: Every missing mandatory version field is rejected.
Every unknown field is rejected.
The reviewed artifact is accepted.

scenarios.arrange: Generate at least 50 distinct clock, job, correlation, and temporary-path envelopes for the same semantic input.
scenarios.act: Run isolated scans and canonicalize each semantic object independently.
assert: All semantic canonical bytes and semantic hashes are byte-identical.
Differences in the full artifact occur only under envelope.
With envelope ports fixed, the complete stdout bytes are identical.

scenarios.arrange: Construct the reviewed commit-A semantic value through generated field insertion permutations and recorded completion schedules.
scenarios.act: Canonicalize and hash every construction independently.
assert: Every construction equals expected-semantic-a.jcs byte for byte.
Every construction has snapshot digest b673624a329f43fd84852bbdeefd66326a7fcb1c03fdb626e2de6bfedff11997.
The property runner records the seed and rejects any order- or schedule-dependent result.

scenarios.arrange: Read Cargo metadata and every first-party manifest for the minimal S0 workspace.
scenarios.act: Evaluate the ratified inward dependency graph, lint inheritance, and unsafe policy.
assert: No forbidden outward dependency edge exists.
Every first-party crate inherits unsafe_code = forbid.
Introducing a seeded forbidden edge makes the check fail.

scenarios.arrange: Load the approved requirement register, immutable oracle-bundle digest, and an instance of tests/specifications/s0/evidence-manifest-v1.schema.json.
scenarios.act: Remove each requirement, fixture, oracle, Red, Green, or evidence reference in turn.
assert: Every missing link, wrong oracle-bundle digest, stale commit, or malformed evidence state is rejected.
Implemented and Verified states cannot be declared without required Green evidence.

scenarios.arrange: Materialize isolated repositories and record the shuffle seed.
scenarios.act: Run the required scenarios in parallel and in 10 shuffled orders without retry-to-green.
assert: All canonical results and typed failures match the serial oracle.
No test shares mutable repository, clock, output, or environment state.

scenarios.arrange: Materialize A, apply the manifest's isolation variant, create a fresh Linux network namespace with no interface up or route, close every inherited descriptor above 2, verify 0/1/2 are non-sockets, compile the ratified seccomp policy, and generate an isolated deny-and-audit probe for every named syscall and conditional branch before entering the monitored product boundary.
scenarios.act: Run a successful scan inside the monitored boundary.
assert: After the initial noesis image load there is no execve, execveat, fork, vfork, or clone3, and no clone lacking CLONE_THREAD; the sentinel remains absent.
No socket, socketpair, socketcall, connect, bind, listen, accept, send, receive, shutdown, or io_uring syscall can create or use a network channel; every listed attempt is denied and audited.
The seccomp self-test report covers every policy rule on the selected architecture; a missing result, unexpected allow, or unproved not_exposed result fails the gate.

The namespace has no interface up or route for the full boundary, only non-socket descriptors 0/1/2 are inherited, and no DNS, resolver broker, credential broker, or remote Git operation is attempted.
The successful artifact still matches the semantic oracle.
